data.body: **[P1] Re-throw finalizer fatals outside CompletableFuture callbacks.** On normal async executions this runs on a reusable handler or checkpoint worker. If result serialization or `onInvocationEnd` throws `VirtualMachineError`/`ThreadDeath`, only `finalized` fails; the worker returns normally and may be reused after a VM/thread-termination fatal. Run finalization on the invocation caller or through an observed executor runnable that rethrows fatal outside CompletableFuture containment, and add an async uncaught-worker regression test.
